_comment: Roster for the COO tier (TRACKER workstream S; org shape in ORG_STRUCTURE.md). Each company gets a COO (agent key <key>-coo) plus its own company specialists (agent key <key>-<role slug>). Adding a company is an entry here + nothing else: personas render from agents/coo.template.md and agents/company-specialist.template.md. allowedSpecialists are the SHARED family specialists this company's COO may request through Lloyd. budgetUsd/cycle feed the per-COO cost ledger (step 3). No apiKey here yet (phase 2 isolation; real keys live in env, never committed).

companies.business: A SaaS wardrobe-inventory tool paired with a consignment marketplace. Revenue comes from memberships and from brokering consignment/resale sales.
companies.goal: Become the default way style-conscious sellers catalog their wardrobe and move pieces, turning idle closets into a managed, monetized inventory.

specialists.focus: Catalog accuracy, item lifecycle (listed/sold/returned), and the wardrobe-inventory data model the product is built on.
Member acquisition and retention, brand voice, content, and campaign planning (drafts only; Lloyd sends).
What buyers browse, save, and purchase; pricing and demand signals; what to surface to inventory and sales.
Consignment pipeline, conversion of listings to sales, and brokering performance.

companies.business: Aftermarket parts supply for Rivian and other electric pickups, Rivian-first. The parts business funds the long-term goal.
companies.goal: A range-extended overland camper built on the Rivian R1T platform. The parts business funds it; until then this is a parts company. Compliance/certification stays bundled under supply chain.

specialists.focus: Sourcing, supplier relationships, lead times, and (for now) compliance/certification for parts.
Parts stock levels, SKUs, fitment data, and reorder points.
Order intake, fulfillment status, and post-sale issues.
Rivian and Slate owner forums, Reddit, and EV-pickup communities: demand signals, fitment gaps, and product ideas.
Producibility, GD&T, and manufacturing standards for parts (inherits the shared family mfg-eng baseline).
B2C parts sales pipeline and conversion.
Brand, content, and campaign planning for the parts line (drafts only; Lloyd sends).

companies.business: Recreational water sports. The primary product is a floating picnic table for lounging in lakes and streams. B2C plus B2B hospitality (hotels and resorts).
companies.goal: Establish the floating picnic table as a category product across direct consumer sales and hospitality (hotel/resort) accounts.

specialists.focus: Sourcing, manufacturing partners, and lead times for the product line.
Finished-goods stock, SKUs, and reorder points.
Order intake, fulfillment, and B2B hospitality account orders.
B2C and B2B hospitality pipeline and conversion.
Brand, content, and campaign planning (drafts only; Lloyd sends).
Producibility, GD&T, and manufacturing standards (inherits the shared family mfg-eng baseline).
